title: Battle of Arachova
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Arachova", at revision 1370432301, opens: "The Battle of Arachova, took place between 18 and 24 November 1826 (N.S.). It was fought between an Ottoman Empire force under the command of Mustafa Bey and Greek rebels under Georgios Karaiskakis. After receiving intelligence of the Ottoman army's maneuvers, Karaiskakis prepared a surprise attack in vicinity of the village of Arachova, in central Greece. On 18 November, Mustafa Bey's 2,000 Ottoman troops were blockaded in Arachova. An 800-man force that attempted to relieve the defenders three days later failed." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q82703, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle in 1826 between Ottoman Empire and Greek rebels". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
